# Erika Life | Bounce Experiences

> Rebound boots (jumping boots) fitness classes in Cairo, Egypt, with Hungarian coach Erika Szenes. "Where joy meets power. Where souls go back to nature." From Hungary to Egypt, from Egypt to worldwide.

## Key facts
- Brand: Erika Life | Bounce Experiences (formerly Erika | Bounce Fit Boots)
- Coach: Erika Szenes, Hungarian coach; 20+ years in fitness and wellness; background in choreography and classical, modern and show ballet; 15+ years bringing her experience from Hungary to Egypt
- Languages: English, Hungarian, Arabic
- What: 60-minute fitness dancing classes on rebound boots (jumping boots, bounce boots). All classes use basic movements.
- Levels: Beginner "Find your bounce" (soft bounce, bounce march, heel tap, side step); Intermediate "Build your power" (knee lift, swing kick, scissor step, hip twist); Advanced "Let it fly" (star jump, sprint knees, squat to lift, turn combo)
- Music: Latin, Masry and remixes
- Price: December 2026 special, 500 EGP per class, limited time
- Next class: 1 December 2026, 6 PM Cairo time; the venue is shared after booking
- Studios and times (Africa/Cairo): New Cairo on Sunday and Tuesday; Heliopolis on Monday and Wednesday; 6–7, 7–8 and 8–9 PM
- Boots: provided in S (EU 36–37), M (EU 38–39) and L (EU 40–42); XS and XL are not in class stock, bring your own; you can always bring your own boots
- Own boots for sale: Basic full black 16,000 EGP; Modified coloured springs 18,000 EGP; Special coloured edition 20,000 EGP; Kids 16,000 EGP; Luxury mirrored edition 25,000 EGP. Reserve with a 50% InstaPay deposit, balance on delivery.
- Booking: on the booking page, then pay with InstaPay and send the booking with the transfer screenshot to Erika, who confirms by reply
